updates.title: Know Your Rights: Eviction Prevention Info Session
updates.summary: Free legal-aid info session covering tenant rights, eviction defenses, and emergency rental assistance.

updates.title: What is the eviction notice period in Delaware?
updates.summary: 5 days for nonpayment of rent, 7 days for lease violations, 60 days for no-cause termination.

updates.title: What can I do if my landlord won't return my security deposit?
updates.summary: Delaware law gives landlords 20 days to return a deposit or provide an itemized list of deductions.

updates.title: How much notice does my landlord have to give before eviction?
updates.summary: Notice periods depend on the reason for eviction — from 5 days for nonpayment up to 60 days for no-cause termination of a year-to-year lease.

updates.title: Delaware raises income threshold for Emergency Assistance eligibility
updates.summary: Effective July 1, Delaware DHSS raised the income threshold for Emergency Assistance — which covers rent, utilities, and emergency shelter — from 100% to 125% of the Federal Poverty Level.

updates.title: West End Neighborhood House expands Life Lines to age 25
updates.summary: West End Neighborhood House has raised the age cap for its Life Lines youth housing program from 23 to 25, effective immediately. The program serves foster care and unaccompanied youth, including LGBTQ+ youth.
